description: Behavior-preserving structural change with baseline proof and architecture constraints.

nodes.objective: Capture existing externally observable behavior and relevant tests/metrics.
acceptance: Known existing failures are separated from refactor regressions.

nodes.objective: Define target boundaries and migration sequence.
acceptance: Legacy surface deletion or compatibility path is planned.
Critical behavior is protected by deterministic tests or documented runtime evidence.

nodes.objective: Perform the smallest staged structural change.
acceptance: Public behavior remains unchanged unless explicitly scoped.
Dead legacy paths are removed when safe.

nodes.objective: Compare post-change behavior to the baseline and run structural checks.
Look for hidden coupling, migration gaps and risk.
Close findings and finalize the migration.
acceptance: No known caller remains on an unintentionally deprecated path.
